text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to do tasks that normally need human intelligence, such as learning, solving problems, and making decisions. Machine learning is a part of AI where computers learn from data instead of following fixed instructions. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning that uses artificial neural networks to handle complex tasks like recognising faces or understanding speech. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. We use it when we ask voice assistants questions, get movie recommendations, translate languages, or unlock phones with our faces. AI is changing the way we live and work.
